plugins.name: @kinetographdev/hexed
plugins.title: Hexed
plugins.description: Rolls a look onto any picture from slots like grade, screen, optics and damage; lock what you like and shuffle the rest.

plugins.name: @kinetographdev/kinetic-typography
plugins.title: Kinetic Typography
plugins.description: Kinetic typography for Kinetograph: type that moves with the voice and the picture.

plugins.name: @kinetographdev/paper
plugins.title: Paper
plugins.description: A paper material with creases, scans and grain, and effects made of it, such as a text match cut and folded cut-outs.

templates.title: Cyberpunk Reel
templates.description: Pop-art cut-in reel (subject cut out of public-domain footage, halftone, rays, title strips, synthesised sound).

templates.title: Lyric Reel
templates.description: A kinetic-type lyric reel in four looks, rebuilt shot for shot from a reference reel's camera work, timing and textures: silver words stacking in a night sky full of glinting stars that streak when the camera moves, black type on an orange band between letterbox bars, small blue words turning in the clouds, and a finale back in the stars.

templates.title: Scrapline
templates.description: A hand-drawn border round a cut-out subject: a wobbly marker, pencil, crayon, scribble or brush line, on a sheet of torn paper behind it.

templates.title: Wish Reel
templates.description: The wish style: an 18 s pop-art edit rebuilt in Kinetograph from a reference reel, and made into a template that runs on any footage.

templates.title: Word Flash
templates.description: A black-and-white type spot for brands, cut on every hit of its track: one word or a two-word lockup per cut, the background swapping black and white at each one.
